sentence: This project builds a gene editing tool to fix a mutation that causes cystic fibrosis, a genetic disorder that damages the lungs and digestive system.
This project studies how extreme weather, natural disasters and changes in where people travel affect women's risk of intimate partner violence in Kenya.
This project studies how proteins called keratins in skin cells control the immune response and the movement of neutrophils in inflamed skin.
This project builds microscope methods that image host cells and microbe cells in the intestines of living mice without labels.
This project studies how small proteins control the sodium pump, an enzyme that moves sodium and potassium across cell membranes.
This project supports scientists who study how healthy vision works and how disease affects it.
This project tries to find out how fatty acids called medium chain fatty acids affect chronic graft-versus-host disease after stem cell transplantation.
This project builds theory and computer tools to model how whole-system behaviors arise in biology, including microbial ecology and synthetic biology.
This project studies how changes in arteries of the brain relate to the progression of Alzheimer's disease and cognitive impairment.
This project tries to find out which tumor antigens dendritic cells present to T cells in human and mouse pancreatic cancer.
This project screens chemicals to find a preclinical candidate that offers a safe treatment option for contraception and reproductive health.
This project gives vision researchers access to advanced microscopes and digital image analysis.
This project studies whether extracellular vesicles from mesenchymal stem cells can repair damaged corneal nerves.
This project builds a computer platform to analyze the effects of genetic mutations linked to schizophrenia.
This project tries to find out how salamanders quickly rebuild adult organs and tissues such as limbs, spinal cords, hearts and brains.
This project studies how opioids affect serotonin neurons in the brain that control breathing.
This project tests how methylation quantitative loci and other genetic changes work in orofacial clefts using genomic and epigenomic editing.
This project tests whether blocking DNA methylation in tumor cells and CAR T cells makes treatment of diffuse midline glioma work better.
